nodes.label: main()
nodes.desc: Parses the target mode, wires every component and starts the service manager (main, L82).

nodes.label: Distributor.New
nodes.desc: Constructs the write path: ring client, HA dedup middleware and push middleware chain (New, L538).

nodes.label: Distributor.Push
nodes.desc: Validates the WriteRequest per tenant and forwards it to the ingesters that own the series (Push, L2284).

nodes.label: RingConfig
nodes.desc: Distributor-side ring flags turned into a ring.Config for ingester clients (toRingConfig, L64).

nodes.label: prePushHaDedupeMiddleware
nodes.desc: Wraps Push with HA dedup and selects the per-request or per-sample strategy (L28, haDedupeStrategy L55).

nodes.label: perSampleDedupe.dedupe
nodes.desc: Drops samples from replicas that are not the elected leader, per HA cluster (dedupe, L84).

nodes.label: haTracker.checkReplica
nodes.desc: KV-store-backed election of the accepting replica per HA cluster (checkReplica, L563).

nodes.label: checkSample
nodes.desc: Per-sample accept/reject decision given replica state and sample timestamp (L746).

nodes.label: findHALabels
nodes.desc: Extracts the configured HA cluster and replica labels from series labels (L725).

nodes.label: newIngester
nodes.desc: Builds the ingester service with ring lifecycler, TSDB manager and compaction service (newIngester, L416).

nodes.label: ingester ring
nodes.desc: Consistent-hash ring (optionally partitioned) mapping tenants and series to ingester owners.

nodes.label: Ingester.PushWithCleanup
nodes.desc: Ingest lifecycle: request accounting, limits, append and stats (PushWithCleanup, L217).

nodes.label: checkInstanceLimits
nodes.desc: Rejects pushes over in-flight, series and bytes limits (L190).

nodes.label: pushSamplesToAppender
nodes.desc: Feeds samples and histograms into the TSDB appender with per-tenant validation (L516).

nodes.label: userTSDB
nodes.desc: Isolated TSDB per tenant: head, WAL, blocks (Appender L205, Compact L238).

nodes.label: Ingester.compactBlocks
nodes.desc: Cuts the head into 2h blocks and runs local compaction (compactBlocks, L345).

nodes.label: Ingester.shipBlocks
nodes.desc: Periodically ships finished blocks to the bucket, zone-aware (shipBlocks, L56).

nodes.label: shipper.Sync
nodes.desc: Uploads block directories and writes meta.json markers (Sync, L108).

nodes.label: NewStoreGateway
nodes.desc: Wires ring, bucket client and per-tenant bucket stores (NewStoreGateway, L146).

nodes.label: StoreGateway.syncStores
nodes.desc: Keeps the set of owned tenant stores in sync with ring changes (syncStores, L396).

nodes.label: StoreGateway.Series
nodes.desc: gRPC Series endpoint for queriers, served only when the tenant is owned (Series, L408).

nodes.label: NewBucketStore
nodes.desc: Per-tenant lazy block reader over object storage (NewBucketStore, L203).

nodes.label: BucketStore.syncBlocks
nodes.desc: Syncs in-memory block list with the bucket index (syncBlocks, L309).

nodes.label: BucketStore.Series
nodes.desc: Streams chunks and series from blocks within the requested range (Series, L577).

nodes.label: bucketIndexReader
nodes.desc: Lazy postings expansion against the block index with caching (ExpandedPostings, L82).

nodes.label: NewMultitenantCompactor
nodes.desc: Sharded compactor service owning tenants via a ring (NewMultitenantCompactor, L380).

nodes.label: metaSyncer.SyncMetas
nodes.desc: Fetches and deduplicates block metadata for owned tenants (SyncMetas, L111).

nodes.label: metaSyncer.GarbageCollect
nodes.desc: Marks duplicate and superseded blocks for deletion (GarbageCollect, L136).

nodes.label: runCompactionJob
nodes.desc: Downloads, merges and re-uploads a group of blocks (runCompactionJob, L257).

nodes.label: block health gate
nodes.desc: Gates concurrent downloads on block health checks (newBlockHealthValidationGate, L586).

nodes.label: BlocksCleaner.cleanUser
nodes.desc: Deletes blocks marked for deletion and stale tenant data (cleanUser, L452).

nodes.label: TSDB blocks bucket
nodes.desc: Durable long-term storage of TSDB blocks on S3, GCS, Azure or any object store.
